page_hero.name: Page Hero
page_hero.description: DXP AI connects to your entire enterprise ecosystem out of the box. 50+ pre-built connectors, open APIs, and a custom SDK mean you're never locked in — and never building from scratch.

item_0.name: Features Item
item_0.heading: Salesforce CRM
item_0.text: Bi-directional sync of leads, contacts, accounts, and opportunities. Trigger personalized DXP AI experiences based on Salesforce lifecycle stage, lead score, or custom fields. Push ZensAI behavioral signals back to Salesforce for richer sales intelligence.

item_1.name: Features Item
item_1.heading: SAP
item_1.text: Connect DXP AI to SAP S/4HANA, SAP Commerce Cloud, and SAP Customer Experience. Real-time product catalog sync, order status integration, and customer account data for personalized B2B portal experiences.

item_2.name: Features Item
item_2.heading: HubSpot
item_2.text: Sync DXP AI visitor behavior and lead intelligence with HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub. Trigger workflows based on content engagement, run ZensAI-powered A/B tests, and unify your marketing attribution.

item_3.name: Features Item
item_3.heading: Marketo
item_3.text: Full Marketo Engage integration for lead capture, nurture automation, and behavioral scoring. DXP AI page and content engagement events flow directly into Marketo programs and smart campaigns in real time.

item_4.name: Features Item
item_4.heading: Microsoft Dynamics
item_4.text: Native Microsoft Dynamics 365 connector for CRM, Sales, and Customer Service. Unified customer profile across Dynamics and DXP AI enables consistent experiences in portals, web, and email — for both B2C and B2B scenarios.

item_5.name: Features Item
item_5.heading: Google Analytics
item_5.text: GA4 integration for unified analytics across DXP AI and Google properties. Server-side tagging for privacy compliance, custom event mapping, and combined ZensAI + GA4 audience segments for cross-channel targeting.

item_6.name: Features Item
item_6.heading: Adobe Analytics
item_6.text: Deep integration with Adobe Analytics for organizations running hybrid AEM/DXP AI stacks. Shared data layer, consistent event taxonomy, and cross-system reporting via Adobe Experience Platform.

item_7.name: Features Item
item_7.heading: Elasticsearch
item_7.text: Extend ZensAI semantic search with your existing Elasticsearch indices. DXP AI can federate search results across your Elasticsearch clusters, combining keyword precision with ZensAI neural ranking for best-of-both-worlds search quality.

item_8.name: Features Item
item_8.heading: Slack
item_8.text: Publish content approval notifications, workflow alerts, and performance digest reports directly to Slack channels. Authors get real-time publish status, editors get review requests, and teams stay aligned without leaving Slack.

item_9.name: Features Item
item_9.heading: Twilio
item_9.text: Trigger SMS and WhatsApp messages from DXP AI journeys via Twilio. Ideal for transactional alerts, OTP authentication in portals, and conversational AI handoffs from ZensAI virtual agents to human agents.

item_10.name: Features Item
item_10.heading: Stripe
item_10.text: Embed Stripe payment flows directly into DXP AI portal and commerce experiences. Subscription management, one-time payments, and invoice rendering — all styled to match your brand without leaving the DXP AI platform.

item_11.name: Features Item
item_11.heading: ServiceNow
item_11.text: Integrate ServiceNow IT Service Management and Customer Service Management with DXP AI portals. Employees and customers can raise tickets, check status, and receive resolution updates — all within the DXP AI portal experience.

section_dark.name: Section Dark
section_dark.heading: Built for Developers
section_dark.text: Don't see your integration? Our open platform gives developers everything they need to build custom connectors in days, not months.

item_0.name: Features Item
item_0.heading: Open API Framework
item_0.text: Full REST and GraphQL APIs for every DXP AI capability. OpenAPI 3.0 spec, interactive Swagger docs, and Postman collections. OAuth 2.0 and API key authentication with rate limiting and usage analytics.

item_1.name: Features Item
item_1.heading: Custom Connector SDK
item_1.text: Build custom connectors using our Node.js or Python SDK. A connector scaffold, testing framework, and marketplace publishing pipeline let your team ship integrations in days. Enterprise customers get private connector registry support.

item_2.name: Features Item
item_2.heading: Webhooks & Event Bus
item_2.text: Subscribe to DXP AI events — content published, user action, segment match, form submit — via webhooks or our managed event bus. Filter, transform, and route events to any downstream system in real time.

cta.name: CTA
cta.heading: Already Have a Stack? DXP AI Connects to It.
cta.description: Talk to our integration team about connecting DXP AI to your specific technology ecosystem. We'll assess your stack and recommend the fastest integration path.
cta.metaText: 50+ pre-built connectors · Open API · Custom SDK
